text: Program Description 1. Program Description Editor Notes: The program focuses upon the Chinese legal system, laws and regulations and transacting international business in China. The program's objective is to provide foreign law professionals and students a foundation in Chinese law, while ensuring their adaption to a Chinese cultural and working environment. Designed to expose students to both the legal theory and legal practice, the program includes full-time study of the law in the first year and the option of writing a thesis or participating in an internship in the second year. LLM applicants are welcome to apply from different career backgrounds, including lawyers working in private law firms and government, government officials, law educators, businessmen and businesswomen and law school J.D. gradutates. The LLM program runs for a period of 2 years. The first year is for taking the classes and the second year is for completing the dissertation and taking internships. 2. Program Structure Editor Notes: The first year consists of two semesters and this year's available courses are listed below. 2.1 Compulsory & Optional Courses Compulsory Courses Optional Courses Introduction to Chinese Law Chinese Political and Legal System Chinese Contract Law Legal Writing Chinese Tort Law Chinese Company Law Chinese Constitutional and Administrative Law Legal Research Chinese Criminal Law and Criminal Procedure Basic Chinese Language Foreign Trade Laws and Regulations in China Introduction to Common Law System Foreign Investment, Merger and Acquisition in China Chinese Intellectual Property Law Chinese Civil Procedure & Arbitration Law Intellectual Property Law Chinese Banking Law and Capital Markets Chinese Insolvency Law and Corporate Reorganizations Chinese Labor Law and Social Security Investment Law 2.2 Trial Classes There are some free trial classes available online for prospective students to get a feel for the program. These introductory classes cover the following areas of Chinese law. Introduction to the Rule of Law in China Setting up or acquiring a business in China China Bankruptcy Law China & the WTO: Current Issues Dispute Resolution Processes in China China Anti-Monopoly Laws 3. Scholarships Scholarships are available for students who want to study on the Residential LLM Program. 4. Dissertation The dissertation should not be more than 12,000 words. Students are required to complete a defense of their dissertation in order to be awarded the LLM. 5. Internships Editor Notes: The School will make inquiries into suitable internships when students are enrolled on the program through connections with the law school. ​Students who are enrolled on the program will have the opportunity to take work experience at a top 5 law firm in China at any point during the two years they are enrolled on the LLM program. The internship period depends on each student and the type of internship that they seek. The purpose of the internship is to gain practical experience and skills working in a Chinese law firm. 6. School Introduction Editor Notes: It is a key university directly affiliated with the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China. Founded in 1941, Beijing Foreign Studies University (BFSU) is the first institution specializing in foreign language studies. It has the longest history among universities of its kind in China, offering a complete range of degrees, diplomas and programs at various levels, with the largest number of foreign language programs in the country. Excellence in teaching and extensive research in foreign language and literature has earned high respect for BFSU’s quality programs, both at home and internationally , Learn More>> 7. Law School of Beijing Foreign Studies University Editor Notes: LLM Program in China Business and Commercial Law is designed to expose students to the legal environment in China The faculty comes from varied backgrounds in the legal profession bringing expertise and experience. The professors are respected scholars, legal practitioners, jurists,legal theorists and researchers. The School has professors who have doctoral degrees and are nationally and internationally recognized al well as adjunct faculty, including leading Justices of the Supreme People's Court, senior judges and prosecutors, partners of leading international law firms, in-house counsel of state-owned enterprises and financial institutions and multinational companies in China. 8.
